pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ancient Factory.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Awakening
pages.text: In singleplayer, use a Nether Star on the inactive Harbinger in the Ancient Factory; one star is consumed. On a dedicated host this native interaction does not replace canonical Start. Bring a melee weapon: a bow alone is not sufficient for the whole fight.

pages.title: When arrows fail
pages.text: At half health or below, the Harbinger rejects hits whose direct entity is an AbstractArrow, including ordinary arrows. This conditional arrow protection does not establish immunity to every ranged attack. Switch to melee or another accepted source. Native deactivation also rejects normal damage.

pages.title: Laser and EMP
pages.text: Leave the beam line. The factory EMP can be charged by a laser hit and then triggered with redstone. It can stun the Harbinger outside its protected laser action; triggering it at an arbitrary moment is not a guaranteed stun.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. $(l:handbook/mechanics/encounters)Starting combat$(/l). In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Block of Witherite, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.text: In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Lost Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
